stages.label.purpose: Accessible name of the sidebar navigation.
stages.label.where: Sidebar (screen-reader label of the nav; not shown).

stages.overview.where: Sidebar link and the Overview screen's heading.

stages.review.where: Sidebar link and the Review screen's heading.

stages.allMusic.purpose: Name of the All music stage.
stages.allMusic.where: Sidebar link and the All music screen's heading.

stages.library.where: Sidebar link and the Library screen's heading.

stages.crates.where: Sidebar link in the Crates section, and the Crates screen's heading.

sidebar.noCrates.where: Sidebar, Crates section, under the Crates link.

sidebar.treeLabel.purpose: Names the tree of crates and folders for screen readers.
sidebar.treeLabel.where: Sidebar, under the Crates link (not shown).

sidebar.expand.purpose: Names the button that opens a folder in the tree for screen readers.
sidebar.expand.where: Sidebar, arrow beside a closed folder (not shown).

sidebar.collapse.purpose: Names the button that closes a folder in the tree for screen readers.
sidebar.collapse.where: Sidebar, arrow beside an open folder (not shown).

search.label.where: Top bar, search slot (accessible name of the box and its group).

search.placeholder.where: Top bar, search slot (an inert placeholder for now).

search.shortcut.where: Top bar, beside the search box.

undo.button.purpose: The Undo button when there is nothing to undo.

undo.shortcut.where: Top bar, beside the Undo button.

undo.action.addToLibrary.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track added to the Library.
undo.action.addToLibrary.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is an "Add to Library".

undo.action.removeFromLibrary.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track removed from the Library.
undo.action.removeFromLibrary.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a "Remove from Library".

undo.action.addFromRekordbox_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: rekordbox tracks added to the Library in one go (one track).
undo.action.addFromRekordbox_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is the add of rekordbox tracks.

undo.action.addFromRekordbox_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: rekordbox tracks added to the Library in one go (several tracks).
undo.action.addFromRekordbox_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is the add of rekordbox tracks.

undo.action.createCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate that was created.
undo.action.createCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Create crate".

undo.action.renameCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate rename, with the old and new names.
undo.action.renameCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a crate rename.

undo.action.deleteCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate that was deleted.
undo.action.deleteCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a crate delete.

undo.action.createFolder.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a folder that was created.
undo.action.createFolder.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a new folder.

undo.action.renameFolder.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a folder rename, with the old and new names.
undo.action.renameFolder.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a folder rename.

undo.action.deleteFolder.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a folder deleted with what was in it.
undo.action.deleteFolder.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a folder delete.

undo.action.moveCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate or folder that was moved.
undo.action.moveCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a move.

undo.action.addToCrate_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track added to a crate.
undo.action.addToCrate_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Add to crate".

undo.action.addToCrate_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: several tracks added to a crate.
undo.action.addToCrate_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Add to crate".

undo.action.addToCrateLibrary_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track added to a crate, which also came into the Library.
undo.action.addToCrateLibrary_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is an add to a crate that also added tracks to the Library.

undo.action.addToCrateLibrary_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: several tracks added to a crate, some of which also came into the Library.
undo.action.addToCrateLibrary_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is an add to a crate that also added tracks to the Library.

undo.action.addToNewCrate_zero.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate made from the add dialog when every track was left out.
undo.action.addToNewCrate_zero.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo made a new crate and added nothing to it.

undo.action.addToNewCrate_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate made from the add dialog, with one track in it.
undo.action.addToNewCrate_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo made a new crate and added a track to it.

undo.action.addToNewCrate_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate made from the add dialog, with several tracks in it.
undo.action.addToNewCrate_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo made a new crate and added tracks to it.

undo.action.addToNewCrateLibrary_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a new crate with one track, which also came into the Library.
undo.action.addToNewCrateLibrary_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo made a new crate and added tracks that were not in the Library.

undo.action.addToNewCrateLibrary_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a new crate with several tracks, some of which also came into the Library.
undo.action.addToNewCrateLibrary_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo made a new crate and added tracks that were not in the Library.

undo.action.removeFromCrate_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track removed from a crate.
undo.action.removeFromCrate_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a removal from a crate.

undo.action.removeFromCrate_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: several tracks removed from a crate.
undo.action.removeFromCrate_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a removal from a crate.

undo.action.dismissBetterFile.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a "Better file available" item that was dismissed in Review.
undo.action.dismissBetterFile.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a dismissed better file.

undo.action.keepAnyway.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Keep anyway" for a quality problem in Review.
undo.action.keepAnyway.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Keep anyway".

undo.action.wantBetterFile.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Find a better file" for a quality problem in Review.
undo.action.wantBetterFile.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Find a better file".

undo.action.switchLinkedFile.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one Library track's linked file switched to another copy in Review.
undo.action.switchLinkedFile.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a switched linked file.

undo.action.acceptClearBestFiles_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Accept all" in Review, which switched linked files in one go (one track).
undo.action.acceptClearBestFiles_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Accept all" for "Clearly best file".

undo.action.acceptClearBestFiles_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Accept all" in Review, which switched linked files in one go (several tracks).
undo.action.acceptClearBestFiles_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Accept all" for "Clearly best file".

undo.action.confirmRelink.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a relink match confirmed in Review.
undo.action.confirmRelink.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a confirmed relink.

undo.action.rejectRelink.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Not the same" said about a relink match in Review.
undo.action.rejectRelink.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a "Not the same".

undo.action.withdrawRelink.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a relink confirmation that was withdrawn.
undo.action.withdrawRelink.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a withdrawn relink confirmation (no screen withdraws one yet).

undo.action.other.purpose: Undo button when the action it takes back has no name of its own.
undo.action.other.where: Top bar, Undo button, for an action this version has no wording for, or one recorded by an older version without its details.

undo.refused.sentSince.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because the tracks it added have been sent to rekordbox since.
undo.refused.sentSince.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.sentSince.approved: Can't undo: tracks have been sent to rekordbox since

undo.refused.sourceGone.purpose: Says a removal from the Library can't be undone because the track, or the file it was linked to, is gone from All music since (its music folder was removed, or the track was merged into another).
undo.refused.sourceGone.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.sourceGone.approved: Can't undo: the track is no longer in All music

undo.refused.crateNameTaken.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because it would bring back a crate name another crate has now.
undo.refused.crateNameTaken.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.crateNameTaken.approved: Can't undo: crate name already used (“{{name}}”)

undo.refused.changedSince.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because something it changed has changed again since.
undo.refused.changedSince.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.changedSince.approved: Can't undo: the Library has changed since

undo.refused.switchSentSince.purpose: Says why Undo is greyed out: the step switched a track's linked file to a copy that goes to rekordbox as a new track, and the track has been sent since, so rekordbox holds that new track now.
undo.refused.switchSentSince.where: Top bar, beside the Undo button, when the next step to undo is such a switch (or an "Accept all" holding one).
undo.refused.switchSentSince.approved: Can't undo: the track has been sent to rekordbox as a new track since

details.label.purpose: Accessible name of the Details panel.
details.label.where: Details panel on the right (screen-reader label).

details.empty.where: Details panel, while no track is selected.

details.file.purpose: Labels the full path of the selected track's file.
details.file.where: Details panel, above the track's path.

details.tags.purpose: Heading over the list of the track's tag fields.
details.tags.where: Details panel, above the tag list.

details.moreDetails.purpose: Switch that shows the other values a field has in other places.
details.moreDetails.where: Details panel, above the tag list; the same wording as Review's switch.

details.loadingTags.purpose: Says the tag list is being read.
details.loadingTags.where: Details panel, while a track's tag sources load.

details.source.rekordbox.where: Details panel, under a field's value, for a Library track rekordbox knows.

details.source.file.purpose: Says a value is the tag of a named file.
details.source.file.where: Details panel, under a field's value (or an other value), naming the file.

details.source.blankInRekordbox.purpose: Says rekordbox has no value for the field; the files' values are listed below.
details.source.blankInRekordbox.where: Details panel, in place of a value, for a track rekordbox knows.

details.source.other_one.purpose: Says one other value exists for the field.
details.source.other_one.where: Details panel, after a field's source, while More details is off.

details.source.other_other.purpose: Says several other values exist for the field.
details.source.other_other.where: Details panel, after a field's source, while More details is off.

details.crates.title.purpose: Heads the list of crates the selected track is in.

details.crates.none.purpose: Says the selected Library track is in no crate.
details.crates.none.where: Details panel, under the crates heading.

details.crates.remove.purpose: Takes the selected track out of the crate beside it; the track stays in the Library.
details.crates.remove.where: Details panel, a plain text action beside each crate the track is in.

details.crates.removed.purpose: Says the track was removed from the crate; {{crate}} is its place in the tree.
details.crates.removed.where: Details panel, status line under the crates after a removal.

details.withdraw.confirmed.purpose: Says the user confirmed the track's file as rekordbox's.
details.withdraw.confirmed.where: Details panel, a Library track whose rekordbox entry was confirmed to its file.

details.withdraw.action.purpose: Takes back the confirmation (one undoable step).
details.withdraw.action.where: Details panel, quiet text button beside the confirmed line.

details.withdraw.hint.where: Details panel, under the withdraw button.

details.withdraw.done.where: Details panel, status line after a withdrawal.

player.label.where: Player bar along the bottom (screen-reader label).

undo.action.keepBoth.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Keep both" for two Library tracks that are the same recording, in Review.
undo.action.keepBoth.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Keep both".

undo.action.mergeTracks.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a merge of Library tracks that are the same recording, in Review (Undo brings the other track back).
undo.action.mergeTracks.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a merge.

undo.refused.mergeLinkChanged.purpose: Why Undo can't take back a merge of two Library tracks: the track that stayed now plays another file (it followed its file, or was switched), and undoing would put two Library tracks on one file.
undo.refused.mergeLinkChanged.where: Top bar, Undo button's refusal, when the next step to undo is such a merge.
undo.refused.mergeLinkChanged.approved: Can't undo: the track that stayed uses a different file since

undo.action.sameTrack.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Same track" in Review, which made the files of a version mix-up or of unclear duplicates one track (Undo puts the files back). Proposal.
undo.action.sameTrack.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Same track".

undo.action.notSameTrack.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Not the same" in Review, which kept two tracks apart (Undo asks again). Proposal.
undo.action.notSameTrack.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Not the same" on a version mix-up or unclear duplicates.

undo.action.splitOffFile.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: Split off in Review (Undo puts the file back in its track). Proposal.
undo.action.splitOffFile.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a split.

undo.action.showFileAgain.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Show again" on a hidden file in All music (Undo hides the file again). Proposal.
undo.action.showFileAgain.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a "Show again".

undo.action.useThisFile.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: "Use this file instead" on an extra copy in the Hidden filter (Undo brings back the file the ranking chose). Proposal.
undo.action.useThisFile.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a "Use this file instead".

undo.action.resolveConflict.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one conflict resolved in Review (Undo opens it again). Proposal.
undo.action.resolveConflict.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is one conflict resolved.

undo.action.resolveConflicts.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: every conflict of a field resolved at once in Review (Undo opens them all again). Proposal.
undo.action.resolveConflicts.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a bulk resolve of a field's conflicts.

undo.action.setEnergy_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: an energy given to one track.
undo.action.setEnergy_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is giving a track an energy.

undo.action.setEnergy_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: an energy given to several tracks at once.
undo.action.setEnergy_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is giving tracks an energy.
